title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information CourtVision ("CourtVision", "we", "us", "our") handles when you use the CourtVision basketball simulator, both the web version and the downloadable Windows edition. We wrote it to be read, so it is plain and specific about what the app actually does.

**The short version:** CourtVision has no accounts and no server-side saves. Your leagues stay in your own browser. The web version uses Vercel Web Analytics and Umami Cloud for aggregate traffic statistics and Google AdSense for advertising when allowed. The offline Windows edition loads neither service.

items: **No account, no sign-up.** We never ask for your name, email address, phone number, or password to play.
**Your leagues stay on your device.** Saved leagues, rosters, settings, and history are stored in your browser (IndexedDB and localStorage) and are not uploaded to us.

**Web traffic statistics.** The web version uses Vercel Web Analytics and Umami Cloud, neither of which sets analytics cookies. We send page categories such as Coaching or Dashboard, and to Umami a few anonymous gameplay events (for example that a game mode was started or finished), not league contents, save identifiers, player names, or game identifiers. See Section 7.
**The web version shows ads.** Ads are served by Google AdSense, which may use cookies and similar technologies. See Section 5.
**The Windows edition makes no network requests of its own.** It runs from a local server on your own computer, shows no Google ads, and keeps everything on your machine.
**Not for children under 13.** See Section 11.

blocks.text: This policy applies to the CourtVision website and to the CourtVision Windows edition (the offline package you can download from the website). It does not apply to third-party websites that ads or links in CourtVision may lead to; those have their own policies.

CourtVision is a simulation game. Player names, teams, and leagues you see are generated by the game or entered by you. The game is not a service for collecting personal data about you, and it is designed so that it does not need to.
We do not collect, receive, or store on any server of ours:

items: your name, email address, postal address, phone number, or any account credentials (there are no accounts);
payment information (CourtVision is free and has no purchases);
your leagues, rosters, trades, notes, custom players, or any other content you create in the game;
your precise location, contacts, photos, microphone, or camera data;
government identifiers, health information, or other sensitive personal information.

blocks.text: Files you choose to import into the game (for example a universe file or player data) are read by your browser on your device. They are not uploaded anywhere. Files you export are saved to your device only.

To let you close the game and come back later, CourtVision stores data in your browser's local storage on your own device. This data is created by you as you play and stays on your device. We cannot see it, access it, or recover it for you.

rows: Your saved leagues (teams, players, schedules, contracts, history, and settings for each save)
Editor and sandbox data such as player overrides, custom badges, saved exhibition games, and settings presets
A legacy single-slot autosave from older versions, read once so an old league is not lost, then no longer used
The identifier of the save you had open last, so the game can reopen it
Your Career Mode players and their leagues
Progress and preferences for the game modes, such as League Hunt runs, challenge records, weekly results, achievements, the graphics setting and which update notes you have seen

Web version: a copy of the game's own files (the page, scripts, styles, icons and NBA history data), so the game opens faster and works offline. It holds no personal data and can be cleared with the site's data

blocks.text: This storage is strictly necessary for the game to work and does not identify you. It is tied to the website address you use (for the Windows edition, that is http://localhost with a port number on your own computer), which is why the same address must be used to see the same saves.

**Your control:** you can delete saves inside the game at any time, or clear this site's data in your browser settings. Clearing site data permanently deletes your saved leagues. To keep a backup, use the game's Export feature, which saves a file to your device.

The address bar and browser history store the current page and a local save identifier so Refresh, Back, and Forward can reopen it. These links only reopen leagues already saved in that browser; sharing a link does not share a league.

CourtVision keeps up to five local restore points per league in the restorePoints table of courtvision-saves. These contain earlier league snapshots and stay on this device. Recovering a point creates a separate saved league. Deleting a saved league also deletes its local restore points; clearing browser data deletes both. Download a backup file to keep a copy outside the browser.

The CourtVision **web version** displays advertising banners to help keep the game free. In the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland, Google's certified consent message asks for your choice first, and Google does not serve ads there until you have answered. Elsewhere, ads load with the page. If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, CourtVision does not request ads at all. Ads can come from two sources.

**Google AdSense.** We use Google AdSense, a service of Google LLC (and, for users in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland, Google Ireland Limited). When ad units load, your browser connects to Google's servers, and Google and its advertising partners may collect and use information such as:

items: your IP address and approximate location derived from it;
your browser type, device type, operating system, language, and screen size;
the page you are viewing and the time of the request;
cookies, mobile advertising identifiers, or similar technologies stored on or read from your device;
how you interact with ads (whether one was shown, viewed, or clicked).

blocks.text: Google uses this information to select and show ads, which may be personalized based on your interests or non-personalized (based on context such as the page content), to limit how often you see the same ad, to measure ad performance, to detect and prevent fraud and abuse, and to comply with legal obligations. Google and other third-party vendors may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites.

We do not receive your personal information from Google or advertisers, and we do not give them anything from your saved leagues. We do not control the cookies or technologies that Google and its partners use. To learn how Google uses information from sites that use its services, see [How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites) and [Google's Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

**Direct sponsor banners.** Some banners may be shown directly by us on behalf of a sponsor. These are ordinary links. They do not load third-party tracking code from us, but if you click one, you leave CourtVision and the sponsor's site handles your information under its own policy. Sponsor links are marked as sponsored.
**Ad choices.** You can control ads in several ways:

items: Turn off personalized advertising in [Google Ads Settings](https://adssettings.google.com).

Opt out of many third-party vendors' personalized advertising at [aboutads.info/choices](https://optout.aboutads.info) or [YourAdChoices](https://youradchoices.com). Users in the European Union can use [Your Online Choices](https://www.youronlinechoices.com).
Opt out of interest-based ads from participating companies through the [Network Advertising Initiative](https://optout.networkadvertising.org).
Use your browser's cookie controls, private browsing, or a content blocker. The game itself works without ads loading.
Send a Global Privacy Control signal from a supporting browser or extension, where the law recognizes it.

blocks.text: **Windows edition.** The downloadable Windows edition does not load Google AdSense and does not contact ad networks. It may show plain sponsor placeholders that are stored inside the app, and clicking a sponsor link opens that sponsor's website in your browser.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies, local storage, and your consent choices

blocks.text: This section explains every cookie-like technology CourtVision uses, and how consent choices control them.

rows: Saving your leagues and settings on your device (Section 4), and remembering your cookie choice itself
CourtVision (local storage only - not a cookie sent to a server)
Always on - the game cannot function without it. You can still clear it any time in your browser's site data settings.
Google AdSense: choosing and measuring ads, and limiting how often you see the same one
Google, only on the web version, only after you allow it below
Off by default. Turn on/off any time via “Cookie Settings” in the footer.

blocks.text: **Consent choices.** Visitors in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland see Google's consent message (Google's certified consent management platform, configured in Google AdSense's Privacy & messaging settings) the first time they open the web version; it offers to accept, refuse, or manage the purposes and vendors involved. Visitors elsewhere are not asked, and ads load with the page. You can review or change your choice at any time using the “Cookie Settings” link in the footer of every page, which reopens Google's consent choices where they apply. Cookie-free web traffic statistics are described in Section 7.

**Turning advertising off.** Refuse in Google's consent message (where it applies), use the Google opt-outs in Section 5, or turn on Global Privacy Control in your browser: with Global Privacy Control on, CourtVision does not request ads. Cookies Google already placed are not retroactively deleted by these controls; clear them in your browser if you want them gone immediately. The Strictly necessary storage described in Section 4 is never affected.
**Global Privacy Control.** If your browser or an extension sends a Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal, CourtVision treats it as an opt-out: no ad requests are made to Google while the signal is on.

**Where consent is recorded.** Your choice is saved in your browser's local storage (the same strictly-necessary storage described in Section 4), not as a cookie and not on our servers, so it applies per browser/device. If you clear your browser's site data, or use a different browser or device, you'll be asked again.

**Certified consent tool.** CourtVision uses Google's own certified consent message, managed in Google AdSense's Privacy & messaging settings, in place of an in-app banner, so you are only asked once. Google does not serve personalized or non-personalized ads to visitors in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland until consent has been given through that message.

**Fonts.** CourtVision's typefaces are bundled with the app rather than loaded from Google Fonts or any other font service, so opening the game does not send a request, your IP address, or any cookie to a font provider.

**Windows edition.** The downloadable Windows edition shows no cookie banner because it loads no cookies, no Google script, and no ad network - it only uses the same on-device storage described in Section 4.

The web version is delivered by a web hosting or content delivery provider. Like almost every website, that provider may automatically process standard technical data when your browser requests a page or file, such as your IP address, request time, requested address, browser and device information, and the response status. This is used to deliver the site, keep it secure, and diagnose problems, under the provider's own privacy terms. We do not use these logs to build profiles of individual players.

**Vercel Web Analytics (web version only).** We use aggregate page-view statistics to understand usage and improve the app. Vercel processes request data and reports page categories, referrers, approximate location, browser, operating system, and device type. It uses a short-lived request-derived identifier rather than analytics cookies; visitor session identifiers expire after 24 hours. Our integration removes save IDs, player/game details, URL query strings, and fragments from page-view URLs. No league data or custom gameplay events are sent. Advertising cookie choices do not control this cookie-free service. See [Vercel Analytics privacy information](https://vercel.com/docs/analytics/privacy-policy). Analytics is disabled in the Windows edition.

**Umami Cloud analytics (web version only).** We also use Umami, a cookie-free analytics service, to count page views. It receives the same page categories as Vercel (for example /game/standings), plus the referrer, browser, operating system, device type, screen size, language and approximate location (country, region and city) derived from your IP address. Umami does not use cookies or store your IP address; it counts visitors with a salted hash that rotates periodically. Our integration turns off automatic tracking and strips save IDs, player or game details, query strings and fragments from every page view. We also send a small set of anonymous gameplay events so we know which parts of the game are played: which mode was started or finished and its broad outcome (for example "career, retired, Hall of Fame" or "League Hunt, lost at series 6"), share-card and backup use, and app installs. Events carry only fixed labels and whole numbers, never names you typed, league contents, save or player identifiers, or free text. No events are sent when your browser sends a Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control signal. See [Umami's privacy information](https://umami.is/privacy). It is not loaded in the Windows edition.

When you download the Windows package, the same kind of technical data is processed for that download. After you extract and run it, the Windows edition runs a small local web server on your computer at an address such as http://localhost:47820. That server only serves the game's own files to your own browser on the same machine and does not send your data anywhere.
We use on-device game data and aggregate web traffic statistics as follows:

items: Data stored on your device is used only by the game, on your device, to save and restore your leagues and settings.
Information handled by Google or other ad partners in connection with ads is used by them for the purposes in Section 5.
Technical data processed by our hosting provider is used to serve and secure the website.
We do not sell your personal information for money, and we do not use your data for automated decisions that have legal or similarly significant effects on you.
Aggregate web traffic statistics help us understand which pages are used and improve the game.

blocks.text: We do not receive or share your saved leagues. Vercel and Umami process web traffic data as described in Section 7. Information handled in connection with ads is processed by Google and its partners, and by our hosting provider, as described above. These companies operate globally, so information such as your IP address may be processed in countries other than your own, including the United States. Where required, Google and other providers rely on recognized transfer safeguards such as standard contractual clauses. We may also disclose information if required to by law, but as explained above we hold very little that could be disclosed.

**Everyone.** You are in control of your game data: view it inside the game, export it, or delete it by removing saves or clearing your browser's site data. You can manage ads as described in Section 5.

**European Economic Area, United Kingdom, and Switzerland.** Where data protection law such as the GDPR or UK GDPR applies, you have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, and object to the processing of your personal data, the right to data portability, the right to withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent (withdrawing does not affect processing before withdrawal), and the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. Our legal bases are: consent for advertising cookies and similar technologies where the law requires it, and our legitimate interest in running and securing a free website. Requests may be answered by explaining where the relevant data sits (your own device, Google, or the hosting provider) and how to manage it there.

**California and other U.S. states.** Under laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (as amended by the CPRA) and similar laws in other states, residents may have rights to know, access, correct, and delete personal information, and to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. We do not sell personal information for money. Some ad-related data flows to Google and its partners through the web version's ads may count as "sharing" or a "sale" under some of these laws. You can opt out by using the controls in Section 5 or by sending a Global Privacy Control signal. We do not discriminate against you for exercising your rights, and we do not knowingly sell or share the personal information of anyone under 16.

**Do Not Track.** There is no consistent industry standard for responding to browser "Do Not Track" signals. CourtVision does not itself track you across sites; third-party ad partners may respond to such signals differently, so please use the opt-outs in Section 5.
To make a request, contact us using the details in Section 14.

CourtVision is intended for a general audience and is not directed to children under 13 (or under 16 where local law sets that age). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children, and the game does not ask for any. Parents and guardians who believe a child has provided personal information to us can contact us and we will act on it. Parents can also use their browser's or device's parental controls, and the ad opt-outs in Section 5, to limit advertising on the web version.

We do not store your leagues on our servers. Aggregate web analytics are processed by Vercel and Umami under their service terms; Vercel's visitor session identifiers expire after 24 hours, and Umami does not use cookies. Data stored in your browser stays there until you delete it. The web version is served over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection where the host provides one. No method of storage or transmission is perfectly secure; because your saves are stored on your device, their safety also depends on the security of your device and browser (for example, other people who use the same browser profile on a shared computer could open your saved leagues). Use the export feature to keep backups.

The game may link to or display content from third parties, such as advertisers and sponsors. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices. Please read the privacy policy of any site you visit from CourtVision.
If you have questions about this policy, want to make a privacy request, or believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact CourtVision:

We may update this policy as CourtVision changes or as laws and ad-network requirements change. When we do, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top. If a change is material, we will make it clearly visible on the site or in the app before it takes effect where practical. Continuing to use CourtVision after an update means you accept the updated policy.
